     6	import os

    10	import pandas as pd

    13	# Materials Project / pymatgen ingestion
    14	from mp_api.client import MPRester
    15	from pymatgen.core import Composition, Structure

    17	# Matminer feature engineering
    18	import matminer
    19	from matminer.featurizers.base import MultipleFeaturizer
    20	from matminer.featurizers.composition import (
    21	    ElementProperty,
    22	    Stoichiometry,
    23	    ValenceOrbital,
    24	    ElementFraction,
    25	)
    26	from matminer.featurizers.structure import (
    27	    DensityFeatures,
    28	    SiteStatsFingerprint,
    29	)
    30	from matminer.featurizers.conversions import StrToComposition
    31	
    32	# Scikit-learn preprocessing
    33	from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
    34	from sklearn.pipeline import Pipeline as SkPipeline
    35	
    36	
    37	API_KEY = "YOUR_MP_API_KEY"
    38	
    39	
    40	def fetch_thermal_candidates(
    41	    api_key: Optional[str] = API_KEY,
    42	    max_results: int = 200,
    43	) -> pd.DataFrame:
    44	    """
    45	    Query Materials Project (mp-api) for thermal-management / insulation candidates.
    46	    Includes compounds with at least one of B, C, N, Si, Al.
    47	    Extracts: Material ID, Pretty Formula, Bulk Modulus (VRH avg), Band Gap.
    48	    Drops rows with missing Bulk Modulus or Band Gap.
    49	    """
    50	    elements_filter = ["B", "C", "N", "Si", "Al"]
    51	    criteria = {
    52	        "elements": {"$in": elements_filter},
    53	        "nelements": {"$gte": 1},
    54	    }
    55	
    56	    with MPRester(api_key or os.getenv("MP_API_KEY", API_KEY)) as mpr:
    57	        results = mpr.query(
    58	            criteria,
    59	            [
    60	                "material_id",
    61	                "formula_pretty",
    62	                "bulk_modulus.vrh",
    63	                "band_gap",
    64	            ],
    65	            chunk_size=max_results,
    66	        )
    67	        records = []
    68	        for doc in results:
    69	            bulk_mod = doc.get("bulk_modulus", {}).get("vrh") if isinstance(doc.get("bulk_modulus"), dict) else doc.get("bulk_modulus")
    70	            if bulk_mod is None:
    71	                bm = doc.get("bulk_modulus")
    72	                if isinstance(bm, dict):
    73	                    bulk_mod = bm.get("vrh")
    74	                else:
    75	                    bulk_mod = bm
    76	            records.append({
    77	                "material_id": doc.get("material_id"),
    78	                "formula_pretty": doc.get("formula_pretty"),
    79	                "bulk_modulus_vrh": bulk_mod,
    80	                "band_gap_ev": doc.get("band_gap"),
    81	            })
    82	    df = pd.DataFrame(records)
    83	    df = df.dropna(subset=["bulk_modulus_vrh", "band_gap_ev"])
    84	    df = df[(df["bulk_modulus_vrh"].notna()) & (df["band_gap_ev"].notna())]
    85	    return df
    86	
    87	
    88	def build_feature_pipeline() -> MultipleFeaturizer:
    89	    """Assemble matminer MultipleFeaturizer for thermal-management descriptors."""
    90	    feat = MultipleFeaturizer([
    91	        ElementProperty.from_preset(preset_name="magpie"),
    92	        Stoichiometry(),
    93	        ValenceOrbital(orbitals=("s", "p", "d", "f"), props=("avg", "frac")),
    94	        DensityFeatures(),
    95	        SiteStatsFingerprint.from_preset("CrystalNNFingerprint_cn"),
    96	    ])
    97	    return feat
    98	
    99	
   100	def build_feature_matrix(df: pd.DataFrame, formula_col: str = "formula_pretty") -> pd.DataFrame:
   101	    """
   102	    Convert formula strings to composition objects via StrToComposition,
   103	    compute ElementFraction features, and flatten into DataFrame.
   104	    """
   105	    converter = StrToComposition()
   106	    # StrToComposition.featurize returns [Composition]; extract Composition objects
   107	    compositions = [converter.featurize(s)[0] for s in df[formula_col].tolist()]
   108	    ef = ElementFraction()
   109	    # ElementFraction expects Composition objects directly
   110	    frac_features = [ef.featurize(c) for c in compositions]
   111	    # Each result is a list of feature values (length equals feature labels count)
   112	    frac_df = pd.DataFrame(frac_features, columns=[str(c) for c in ef.feature_labels()])
   113	    result = pd.concat([df.reset_index(drop=True), frac_df.reset_index(drop=True)], axis=1)
   114	    return result
   115	
   116	
   117	def extract_features(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
   118	    """
   119	    Convert raw MP structures to composition strings, run matminer featurization,
   120	    and merge back into a feature matrix.
   121	    """
   122	    # Build composition column required by matminer
   123	    df["composition_str"] = df["formula"].apply(lambda f: f if isinstance(f, str) else str(f))
   124	
   125	    featurizer = build_feature_pipeline()
   126	    # Real featurizer invocation on the dataset
   127	    features_df = featurizer.featurize_df(df, col_id="composition_str", multiindex=False)
   128	    return features_df
   129	
   130	
   131	def run_full_pipeline(
   132	    api_key: Optional[str] = None,
   133	    output_path: str = "thermal_materials_features.csv",
   134	) -> str:
   135	    """End-to-end Phase 1 ingestion + feature engineering."""
   136	    print("[Phase 1] Fetching thermal-management candidates from Materials Project...")
   137	    raw_df = fetch_thermal_candidates(api_key=api_key, max_results=200)
   138	    print(f"[Phase 1] Ingested {len(raw_df)} records.")
   139	
   140	    print("[Phase 1] Engineering compositional + structural features via matminer...")
   141	    features_df = extract_features(raw_df)
   142	    print(f"[Phase 1] Generated feature matrix: {features_df.shape[1]} descriptors x {len(features_df)} materials.")
   143	
   144	    # Write engineered dataset
   145	    features_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
   146	    print(f"[Phase 1] Feature matrix written to: {os.path.abspath(output_path)}")
   147	    return output_path
   148	
   149	
   150	if __name__ == "__main__":
   151	    out_file = run_full_pipeline()
   152	    print("Pipeline complete. Output:", out_file)
